newsitem.title: USA: SIS Bancorp adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: SIS Bancorp adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: SIS Bancorp Inc said Thursday that its board has adopted a shareholder rights plan.

Under the plan, holders of common stock of record as of the close of business on February 3 will receive one right for each share held entitling them to buy one one-hundredth of a preferred share at $100.
The rights would be triggered if a person or a group acquires 10 percent or more of the company's outstanding common stock, company spokeswoman Ting Chang said.
Chang said SIS Bancorp's charter currently limits holdings of a group or person to 4.9 percent of the total stock outstanding. The limitation will expire on February 7, 1998, she said.

SIS Bancorp said initial issuance of the rights has no dilutive effect on its shares outstanding or earnings and is not taxable. If the rights were not triggered or redeemed by the board, they would expire on January 22, 2007, it said.
